questions.stem: Which statement correctly compares the nervous system and the endocrine system?

options.text: The nervous system produces slower, longer-lasting responses than the endocrine system
The endocrine system uses electrical impulses to transmit information
The nervous system produces fast, short-lived responses while the endocrine system produces slower, longer-lasting responses
Both systems transmit information at the same speed

questions.explanation: The nervous system uses electrical impulses for fast, short-lived responses. The endocrine system uses hormones carried in the blood, producing slower but longer-lasting effects.
